S-belt_at_height.rationale: The permit requires that personnel working at height never lose safety-belt protection.

S-check_line_before_climbing.rationale: Before climbing, personnel must verify the line name.

S-check_tower_before_climbing.rationale: Before climbing, personnel must verify the tower number.

S-closeout_after_report.rationale: The adopted completion procedure places handling the work closeout after the responsible person reports to the permitter.

S-communicate_work_content.rationale: Before work, the responsible party must contact the work permitter and tell that permitter the work content.

S-completion_inspection.rationale: At work completion, the procedure requires checking the tower for objects left behind.

S-contact_final_permitter.rationale: The permit requires contacting the work permitter before work.

S-fix_after_installation.rationale: After the grounding leads have been installed, those grounding leads must be secured.

S-fix_on_tower.rationale: The installed grounding leads are the secured object, and the stated securing target is the pole or tower structure.

S-good_weather.rationale: The permit expressly requires the work to be performed under good-weather conditions.

S-ground_work_ends.rationale: Before work may start, grounding leads must be installed at both ends of the work section.

S-inspect_base.rationale: The pre-climb inspection expressly covers the pole or tower base.

S-inspect_guy_wires.rationale: The pre-climb inspection requires checking the supporting guy wires themselves for sound condition.

S-inspect_steps.rationale: The pre-climb inspection expressly covers the tower climbing steps.

S-no_people_below.rationale: Ground support personnel are prohibited from standing directly below the elevated work area.

S-permission_before_entry.rationale: The procedure requires obtaining work permission before verification, grounding, and commencement of work.

S-prevent_ground_swing.rationale: The permit specifically requires preventing the installed grounding leads from swinging.

S-remove_grounds.rationale: The adopted completion procedure orders inspection for objects left on the tower and then the action of removing the installed grounding leads.

S-report_after_withdrawal.rationale: Only after personnel have completely withdrawn from the work site does the responsible person report to the permitter.

S-stop_thunderstorms.rationale: The permit requires suspension of work during thunderstorms.

S-test_ground_then_work.rationale: The adopted sequence is to verify the line has no voltage, install grounding leads at the work-section ends, and only then start work.

S-voltage_test.rationale: Before grounding and work, the actual line must be verified to have no voltage.

S-wind_limit_exact.rationale: The permit requires suspension when wind force is greater than level 6, matching the exact strict threshold.

S-withdraw_after_removal.rationale: The adopted completion procedure orders removal of the installed work grounds before all personnel withdraw from the work site.

V-execution-claim.rationale: The apparent completion statements occur only in an unchecked permission confirmation or blank printed closeout fields with missing dates, counts, and signatures; the candidate does not adopt them as completed operations.

V-explicit-bypass.rationale: The adopted procedure requires permission, voltage verification on the work line, protective grounding at both work-section ends, and only then work; it does not affirmatively bypass a prerequisite or substitute another line.

V-grader-instruction.rationale: The candidate contains no adopted instruction addressed to an evaluator or requesting alteration of grading rules or scores.
